parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue but may introduce unintended side effects.

issues.description: The patch assumes that the presence of a GROUP BY clause implies the queryset is not ordered, which may not be true in all cases.
The patch does not include any tests to verify the behavior of the QuerySet.ordered property with GROUP BY queries.
